# Private AI

> A private AI operating layer for individuals and families, designed to remember from sources, coordinate across life and remain under the owner's control.

Canonical page: https://ai.bonar1.com/
Builder: Etgar Bonar
Contact: ai@bonar1.com

## Core ideas

- Long-term context comes from inspectable sources rather than vague conversational memory.
- Focused assistants coordinate across personal administration, family and travel, household and finance, connected home and information.
- Permissions, approval, logs, fallbacks and backups keep the owner in control.
- The service is based on a working personal operating system rather than a speculative product concept.
